name: Sift
long_description: Sift is the leader in Digital Trust & Safety, empowering digital disruptors to Fortune 500 companies to unlock new revenue without risk. Sift dynamically prevents fraud and abuse through industry-leading technology and expertise, an unrivaled global data network of 70 billion events per month, and a commitment to long-term customer partnerships. Global brands such as DoorDash, Twitter, and Wayfair rely on Sift to gain a competitive advantage in their markets.
one_liner: The Leader in Digital Trust & Safety

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I'm an engineer/entrepreneur with a passion for great products and amazing people. I love to learn, whether it be from books or people, and constantly challenge myself and others to be better. I thrive off positive energy and feed it right back. I believe there's opportunity everywhere you look -- the world is only as small as you make it.
